caption: The drawing shows a detailed depiction of a horse bridle, consisting of various components primarily in shades of brown, with leather and rope textures clearly illustrated. The browband, noseband, and parts of the reins are decorated with geometric beadwork patterns featuring pink, purple, blue, and white colors in diamond and zigzag shapes. The headstall and reins are primarily brown and appear to be made of braided leather or rawhide. The mouthpiece and curb chain are rendered in a metallic gray color, indicating silver or steel construction, with decorative engravings visible on the cheek pieces. The composition is clear and centered, with each element of the bridle and reins displayed in a realistic and proportionate manner, on a plain, light-colored background. The artist's signature, "Cordena Jackson," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Bridle
